signing.note: Signed by authorised signatory with company seal. Confirm signing format with your AD bank branch.

channels.title: {bank} Internet Banking / Trade Portal
steps: Log in to your bank's corporate banking or trade portal.
Check for trade finance / export regularisation document submission.
Confirm the digital submission menu path with your branch as submission steps vary by bank.

channels.title: Email to Branch or Relationship Manager
steps: Open the email draft to your {bank} branch or Relationship Manager.
Attach the downloaded EDF PDF, the invoice XLSX spreadsheet, and invoice copies.
Send before {dueDate} and request an acknowledgement email or reference number.
Save the bank's written acknowledgement and upload it back to Korra.

channels.title: {bank} Branch / Trade Desk
steps: Print the downloaded EDF (RBI Annex) and sign it with company seal.
Include invoice copies and service agreements.
Submit at the Trade Desk or branch of {bank} before {dueDate}.
Collect the stamped acknowledgement copy and upload it to Korra.

email.subject: EDF Submission - {month} - {bank} (AD Code: {adCode})
email.intro: Please find attached our Export Declaration Form (EDF) and supporting export invoice documents for {month} under FEMA 23(R).
